title: 第15章 碎石拳第16章 初窥门径
slug: 游戏入侵开局挖掌天瓶
content_zh:
废弃死矿道的深处，寂静如坟墓。
苏寒盘膝坐在阴暗的角落，将最后一块用来封堵入口的巨石严丝合缝地推入死角。悲空寺的高僧和玄衣卫刚刚像篦子一样梳理过这里，按照常理，短时间内绝不会有第二波搜查。
这里，现在是整个青叶城赤铁矿最安全的绝对死角。
“打开面板。”苏寒在心中默念。
半透明的淡蓝色光幕在视网膜上弹开，跳过基础属性，苏寒的目光直接锁定了最下方的【技能功法】一栏。
【内功：《八部天龙诀》（残卷）——第一层（入门11000）】【外功：《碎石拳》（不入流）——未入门（0100）】
苏寒盯着《碎石拳》后方那个刺眼的“0100”熟练度，眼神中闪过一丝极度冷静的疯狂。
在《荒域》的底层逻辑中，武技的熟练度并非简单的数字累加。每一次出拳，都必须将肉体逼到极限，甚至产生实质性的肌肉撕裂与骨骼微震，系统才会判定为“有效修炼”，从而增加熟练度。
像《碎石拳》这种不入流的外家硬功，发力方式极其粗暴。普通矿工如果强行修炼，每天最多只能挥出五十拳，双手就会皮开肉绽、骨骼挫伤。如果不辅以昂贵的药酒浸泡，第二天双手就会彻底废掉。
这就是为什么赵强拿到秘籍却不敢练，也是为什么底层流民极难跨越阶层的原因——穷文富武，没钱买药，连练低级武功的资格都没有。
但苏寒不同。
他拥有一流内功《八部天龙诀》。
这门佛门护法神功，本就是为了在极端恶劣的环境下锤炼肉身而创。那一缕盘踞在丹田的淡金色真气，虽然微弱，却拥有着极其恐怖的生机与恢复力。
“外功撕裂血肉，内功修复暗伤。互为表里，生生不息。”
苏寒在脑海中，将两门功法的特性进行了最精密的推演。
结论得出：他，可以成为一台不知疲倦、无视伤痛的永动机。
苏寒站起身。
他脱下那件早已破烂不堪的麻布上衣，随手扔在满是污泥的地上。露出线条犹如钢丝般绞紧、布满大大小小暗红色结痂的上半身。
他走到矿道最深处，面对着一面坚硬无比、纯度极高的赤铁矿原石岩壁。
双腿微分，扎下马步。脊椎骨如同大龙般节节贯穿。

脑海中，《碎石拳》的行气路线和发力技巧瞬间闪过。
“砰！”
苏寒没有丝毫留手，一记直拳，狠狠砸在粗糙尖锐的岩壁上。
9点力量的纯粹爆发，让这一拳沉重如铁。
岩壁上崩落几粒碎石。而苏寒的指关节上，皮肤瞬间破裂，鲜血淋漓。十指连心的剧痛顺着神经末梢疯狂传递向大脑。
【叮！《碎石拳》熟练度+1】
听到这一声提示音，苏寒那张毫无表情的脸上，竟然浮现出了一抹病态的愉悦。
在《荒域》这个残酷的世界里，还有什么比付出就能立刻看到进度条上涨，更让人感到安心的呢？
痛苦？
高达11点的恐怖精神力，犹如一堵无形的叹息之墙，将大脑对痛觉的感知强行压制、剥离。
“痛觉，只是一种提醒肉体受损的负面debuff。只要生命值不归零，就可以彻底无视。”
苏寒眼神冰冷，左手收回，右拳再次如同炮弹般轰出！
“砰！”
【熟练度+1】
“砰！”
【熟练度+1】
“砰！砰！砰！”
沉闷的撞击声，在幽深死寂的矿道里开始回荡。
十拳。二十拳。五十拳。
不到半个时辰，苏寒的双手已经血肉模糊。白森森的指骨隐约可见，鲜血顺着岩壁的纹理往下流淌，在地上汇聚成一小滩触目惊心的暗红色。

双臂的肌肉纤维因为过度压榨而开始痉挛。
若是常人，此刻早就痛晕过去，或者双手彻底报废。
但苏寒没有停。
content_en:
Deep in the abandoned dead mine tunnel, the silence is like a tomb.
Su Han sat cross-legged in a dark corner and pushed the last boulder used to block the entrance into the blind corner. The eminent monks and Xuanyi guards of Beikong Temple have just combed through this place like a grate. According to common sense, there will never be a second wave of searches in a short time.
This is now the safest and absolute blind spot in the entire Aoba City hematite mine.
"Open the panel." Su Han said silently in his heart.
The translucent light blue light screen bounced on the retina, skipping the basic attributes, Su Han's eyes directly locked on the [Skills and Techniques] column at the bottom.
[Internal strength: "Eight Parts of Heavenly Dragon Jue" (Fragmentary Scroll) - First Level (11000 for Entry Level)] [External Strength: "Stone Fist" (Not Popular) - Not for Entry Level (0100)]
Su Han stared at the dazzling "0100" proficiency level behind "Stone Fist", with a trace of extremely calm madness flashing in his eyes.
In the underlying logic of "Desolate Realm", martial arts proficiency is not a simple accumulation of numbers. Every punch must push the body to the limit, and even cause substantial muscle tears and bone microtremors, before the system will judge it as "effective practice", thereby increasing proficiency.
An unfashionable outsider's hard skill like "Stone Fist" has an extremely rough way of exerting force. If ordinary miners practice forcefully, they can only throw up to fifty punches a day, and their hands will be bruised and bruised. If not soaked in expensive medicinal wine, your hands will be completely useless the next day.
This is why Zhao Qiang did not dare to practice even though he got the secret book, and why it is extremely difficult for the lower-class refugees to cross class - they are poor in literature and martial arts, have no money to buy medicine, and are not even qualified to practice low-level martial arts.
But Su Han is different.
He possesses the first-class internal strength "Eight Parts of Heavenly Dragon Art".
This Buddhist magical power to protect the Dharma was originally created to temper the physical body in extremely harsh environments. That wisp of pale golden energy entrenched in the Dantian, although weak, possesses extremely terrifying vitality and resilience.
"External strength tears flesh and blood, and internal strength repairs hidden wounds. The outside and inside are mutually reinforcing, and life is endless."
Su Han conducted the most precise deduction on the characteristics of the two techniques in his mind.
The conclusion is drawn: He can become a perpetual motion machine that is tireless and ignores pain.
Su Han stood up.
He took off the already tattered linen jacket and threw it on the muddy ground. The upper body was exposed, with lines as tight as steel wires and covered with large and small dark red scabs.
He walked to the deepest part of the mine tunnel and faced a rock wall of extremely hard and extremely pure hematite raw stone.
Spread your legs slightly and get into a horse stance. The vertebrae run through each joint like a dragon.
In his mind, the Qi path and force-generating techniques of "Stone Fist" flashed instantly.
"Bang!"
Su Han didn't hold back at all, and hit the rough and sharp rock wall with a straight punch.
The pure burst of 9 points of power made this punch as heavy as iron.
A few gravels fell off the rock wall. On Su Han's knuckles, the skin broke instantly and dripped with blood. The severe pain from the fingers to the heart is transmitted crazily along the nerve endings to the brain.
【bite! "Stone Fist" proficiency +1】
Hearing this prompt, Su Han's expressionless face suddenly showed a touch of morbid joy.
In the cruel world of "Desolate Land", what is more reassuring than seeing the progress bar increase immediately after you pay?
pain?
The terrifying mental power of up to 11 points is like an invisible wall of sighs, forcibly suppressing and stripping away the brain's perception of pain.
"The pain is just a negative debuff that reminds the body of damage. As long as the health value does not return to zero, it can be completely ignored."
Su Han's eyes were cold, he retracted his left hand, and his right fist blasted out like a cannonball again!
"Bang!"
[Proficiency +1]
"Bang!"
[Proficiency +1]
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
The dull sound of impact, in the deep and silent mineThe Tao began to echo.
Ten punches. Twenty punches. Fifty punches.
In less than half an hour, Su Han's hands were already bloody. Bai Sensen's finger bones were vaguely visible, and blood flowed down along the texture of the rock wall, gathering into a small pool of shocking dark red on the ground.
The muscle fibers in both arms began to spasm from being overly compressed.
If it were an ordinary person, he would have fainted from the pain right now, or his hands would be completely disabled.
But Su Han didn't stop.
